About us · since 2019

A travel desk
in Al Ghubra.

DestiniGo opened in Al Ghubra, Muscat in 2019 as a full-service travel desk: flights, visas, hotels, Umrah, tours and insurance arranged from one counter, by one team.

The way we work has not changed since. You send a message, a person reads it, and that same person stays with your trip until you are home again.

2019In Al Ghubra since
09Services on one file

What we do

Every part of the trip,
on one file.

Book one service or hand us the whole trip. Either way it stays with one person from first message to landing.

Airline ticketing Every major carrier out of Muscat, held and reissued without the call-centre queue. Visa services Worldwide applications prepared, checked and submitted — before you book anything. Tour & holiday packages Built around your dates and budget, not pulled off a shelf. Umrah packages Visa, flights, hotel and transport as one arrangement, for individuals and groups. Hotel booking Worldwide, at rates you won't find yourself. Honeymoon Quiet planning, no surprises on the day. Cruise packages Cabins, transfers and shore days. Oman tour packages Musandam, Nizwa, the wadis and desert nights — day trips and longer. Other services Travel insurance and medical travel — added to any booking, or arranged on their own. How it works

From a message to
all your travel needs.

No booking engine and no card details at enquiry. You send what you need, a person reads it, and the same person stays with your file until you are home.

01

Tell us where

A WhatsApp message is enough — city, rough dates, how many of you, and the passport you'll travel on.

  • Quotes are free
  • No obligation to book
Takes a minute
02

Fares compared across airlines, hotels, and the visa rules for your nationality — priced together, with what is and isn't included spelled out.

  • Tickets and vouchers sent to you
Nothing charged before you agree

Whoever quoted your trip handles the changes, the reissues and anything that comes up while you're away.

Come and see us

A travel desk you

Most of it starts as a message — but if you would rather talk it through, the door is open at Ghobra City Plaza in Al Ghubra, a few minutes from the main road.

WhatsApp+968 9756 6609→ Emaildestinigott@gmail.com→ Call+968 2256 9192→ OfficeGhobra City Plaza, Al Ghubra, Muscat

Enquiry — not a booking

Send it another way:

Open in Gmail → Open my mail app

Or write to destinigott@gmail.com yourself — the message is below.

Send enquiry delivers your message straight to our inbox — no email app needed, nothing to install. Send on WhatsApp opens a chat with the same details already written, which is the quicker route on a phone.

Either way this only sends us a message. It does not reserve, hold or book anything, and it never asks for card or passport details. We reply with options and a price, and nothing is confirmed until you say so.

On visas: we prepare, check and submit the application, but the decision rests with the consulate or issuing authority — approval and timing are never guaranteed, and requirements can change without notice. We'd advise not booking non-refundable tickets or hotels until a visa has been issued.
